basics.name: Aniket Mishra
basics.label: Stellar Evolution • Binary Stars • Computational Astrophysics
basics.summary: Physics major at IISER Kolkata interested in stellar evolution, binary star physics, and computational astrophysics. Computed a grid of ~2000 stellar evolution models using MESA spanning stellar masses from 0–100 M☉, leading to the development of the Stellar Evolution Atlas and an open dataset of stellar models.

research.name: Stellar Evolution Atlas
research.summary: Independent research project computing a grid of ~2000 stellar evolution models using MESA across stellar masses from 0–100 M☉ and varying metallicities. Analyzed HR diagram evolution, stellar lifetimes, and temperature–density tracks. Results presented through an interactive Stellar Evolution Atlas website with an open dataset of stellar models.

research.name: Remote Research Project
research.summary: Ongoing remote research project exploring binary evolution physics and stability criteria in massive star systems using stellar evolution models, in discussion with Alejandro Vigna-Gómez.

projects.name: Micromagnetic Simulation of Hysteresis Loops
projects.summary: Simulated magnetization dynamics using Ubermag (Python interface to OOMMF) to study the effect of exchange energy variations on hysteresis loop behavior in cubic magnetic systems.
